rows.Origin:
Bred by Reimer Kordes (1922-1997) (Germany, 1972).
Introduced in Australia by Roy H. Rumsey Pty. Ltd. in 1974 as 'Lolita'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot or apricot blend. Flowers golden bronze. Moderate fragrance. 28 petals. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Notes: Some differences of opinion about parentage, See References.
